import Mathlib.Data.Set.NCard
import Mathlib.Data.Finset

open Finset

theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} (t : Finset ι) (s : ι → Set α) :
  (⋃ i ∈ t, s i).ncard ≤ ∑ i ∈ t, (s i).ncard := by
  let f : Set α → ℕ := λ x, x.ncard
  have h0 : f ∅ = 0 := by simp [f, ncard_empty]
  have hadd : ∀ {s t : Set α}, f (s ∪ t) ≤ f s + f t := by
    intro s t
    rw [f, f, f]
    exact ncard_union_le_add s t
  apply Finset.apply_union_le_sum f h0 hadd
  exact t
